hook: Tune one fight clock: Eggs hatch Chicks inside the enemy's line, and your sleepers wake untouched as a second wave.
loop: Lay Eggs in enemies and Wind the clock at Start of Combat.
Every third attack strikes the hour: Chicks hatch, sleepers wake, effects fire.
Chicks hit hosts from inside; the Leaver turns survivors into lasting stats.

growth.line: Mostly grows each hour inside a fight; Brood, sleepers and the Leaver add slower permanent stats.

feel.early: Cheap Eggs and dozing bodies; Wind sets the pace.
feel.mid: Pick your speed: early Eggs, late sleepers, or many hours.
feel.late: Copy their biggest unit; Chicks bank stats on wins.

stars.why: Hatches a copy of their biggest unit that hits its host.
Puts any tribe's unit safely to sleep, then grows it.
Grows only if never needed, so it fights your own Wind.

card_short.u01: Lays a small Egg in the enemy across.
card_short.u02: Sturdy body, Asleep until the 1st hour.
card_short.u03: On the hour: permanently buffs a unit beside it.
card_short.u04: Wind 2: ticks your clock at Start of Combat.
card_short.u05: Gold next turn for hours struck last fight.
card_short.u06: Chicks copy their host's shared keywords, gaining stats each.
card_short.u07: Sends its right neighbour to sleep; it wakes +4/+4.
card_short.u08: Brood +1 each turn, and when an Egg is lost.
card_short.u09: Asleep until the 7th hour; grows each turn unwoken.
card_short.u10: Egg in their top attacker; Chick gets half its Attack.
card_short.u11: Winds the clock for gold you left unspent.
card_short.u12: On the hour: your Chicks gain +1/+1.
card_short.u13: On the hour: permanently buffs your Asleep units.
card_short.u14: Your On the hour effects trigger twice.
card_short.u15: Lays an Egg in every enemy front-row unit.
card_short.u16: Asleep until the 3rd hour; grows when friends die.
card_short.u17: Clock strikes every 2nd tick; buffs your Clockworks permanently.
card_short.u18: Egg in their biggest unit hatches a Chick copying it.
card_short.u19: Surviving Chicks permanently give their stats to whoever laid them.
card_short.x01: Marker on an enemy; hatches a Chick on your hour.
card_short.x02: Your fight-only unit, sized by its Egg plus Brood.

builds.name: Brood parasites
builds.line: Early hours hatch Eggs before hosts swing; the Leaver banks the Chicks.

builds.name: Clock tower
builds.line: Many hours: hour effects, doubled by Doorkeeper, buff even other tribes' carries.

builds.name: Sleeping Vault
builds.line: Slow clock: untouchable sleepers grow, then wake as a second wave.

liked: One clock that Eggs, sleepers and hour engines each want set differently.
Sleeping-Vault Warden guards any tribe's engine; Gernegroß turns their best unit against them.
worries: Watch: Gernegroß plus Midsummer Leaver banks a golden carry's stats every win.
Watch: Tower Doorkeeper doubles Rohrsang's uncapped buff; Egg-Painter's Brood stacks without limit.
changed: Chick and sleep rules written plainly: a Chick is always your awake unit.
Chicks attack after your other units; a unit slept twice wakes later.
Egg-Painter now turns a lost Egg into Brood once a fight.
verdict: Rated 7 fun, 8 distinct; third of its seed's three and not a run pick. For players who enjoy tuning timing and positioning.
